classification.difficultyReason: Linked parts scaffold coefficient comparison, squaring and adding, quadrant selection, equation solving and a related sketch.

children.label: a
children.prompt: If $\cos x-\sin x=A\cos(x+\alpha)$, show that $A\cos\alpha=1$ and $A\sin\alpha=1$.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}A\cos(x+\alpha)&=A\cos x\cos\alpha-A\sin x\sin\alpha\end{aligned}$$
Comparing coefficients of $\cos x$ and $\sin x$ gives
$$\begin{aligned}A\cos\alpha&=1\\-A\sin\alpha&=-1\\A\sin\alpha&=1.\end{aligned}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the positive value of $A$ by squaring and adding.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}\tan\alpha&=\frac{A\sin\alpha}{A\cos\alpha}\\&=\frac11\\&=1.\end{aligned}$$
Since $A>0$, both $\sin\alpha>0$ and $\cos\alpha>0$, so $\alpha$ is in quadrant I.
$$\alpha=\frac\pi4.$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: Solve the equation $\cos x-\sin x=-1$, for $0\le x\le2\pi$.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}\sqrt2\cos\left(x+\frac\pi4\right)&=-1\\\cos\left(x+\frac\pi4\right)&=-\frac1{\sqrt2}.\end{aligned}$$
The transformed domain is $\dfrac\pi4\le x+\dfrac\pi4\le\dfrac{9\pi}4$.
$$\begin{aligned}x+\frac\pi4&=\frac{3\pi}4,\ \frac{5\pi}4\\x&=\frac\pi2\text{ or }\pi.\end{aligned}$$

children.label: e
children.prompt:
Write down the amplitude and period of $\cos x-\sin x$.
Hence sketch $y=\cos x-\sin x$, for $0\le x\le2\pi$.
Indicate on your sketch the line $y=-1$ and the solutions of the equation in part d.

answer.short: Amplitude: $\sqrt2$. Period: $2\pi$. The line $y=-1$ meets the curve at $x=\dfrac\pi2$ and $x=\pi$.
answer.worked:
$$y=\sqrt2\cos\left(x+\frac\pi4\right).$$
Amplitude: $\sqrt2$. Period: $2\pi$.
The sketch has minimum $\left(\dfrac{3\pi}4,-\sqrt2\right)$, maximum $\left(\dfrac{7\pi}4,\sqrt2\right)$ and zeros at $x=\dfrac\pi4,\dfrac{5\pi}4$. The intersections with $y=-1$ give $x=\dfrac\pi2$ or $\pi$.

spec.description: Equation-driven cosine sketch with all eight source x ticks, four y ticks, extrema guides and the finite y=-1 guide through both solutions. The supplied blue answer graph is mapped to the standard blue series colour; ordinary axes and labels use black.
spec.mathematics: y=cos(x)-sin(x)=sqrt(2)cos(x+pi/4), 0<=x<=2pi; roots pi/4 and 5pi/4; minimum (3pi/4,-sqrt(2)); maximum (7pi/4,sqrt(2)); y=-1 intersections pi/2 and pi.
